name: Head of Kelris
summary: Agents of the Argent Dawn seek Kelris's severed head to confirm his fall and the end of his sacrifices.

sections.title: A Trophy of Ruin
sections.body: In Blackfathom Deeps, Twilight Lord Kelris led sacrifices to Aku'mai, a monstrous servant of an Old God. Taking his head marks the end of his rule over the Twilight's Hammer cultists and their naga allies in the cavern. The head must reach the surface so leaders can know his bloody ceremonies have ended.

sections.title: Proof for the Dawn
sections.body: The Argent Dawn had presumed Kelris dead or lost for months before his influence returned with Kalimdor's encroaching shadows. His head, brought to agents in Darnassus or Thunder Bluff, settles lingering bounties and confirms that his attempt to plunge the world into primeval chaos has been stopped.

faq.answer: Twilight Lord Kelris led the Twilight's Hammer sect in Blackfathom Deeps. Allied with the naga, he sacrificed innocents to Aku'mai, a hydra servant of an Old God, seeking dark power and ancient chaos.

faq.q: Who wants the Head of Kelris?
aliases: who do i give kelris head to
faq.answer: Alliance champions take the head to Dawnwatcher Selgorm in Darnassus. Horde adventurers bring it to Bashana Runetotem on the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff. Selgorm serves the Argent Dawn, while Bashana belongs to the Cenarion Circle.

faq.q: Why does the Argent Dawn care about Kelris?
faq.answer: The Argent Dawn tracks threats to Azeroth. Kelris had long eluded them, and his Old God worship and sacrifices of innocents threatened Kalimdor's balance.
The head comes from Twilight Lord Kelris's corpse in his sanctum within Blackfathom Deeps, beneath the Zoram Strand on Ashenvale's coast.

angles.text: As an Alliance champion, you take Kelris's head to Dawnwatcher Selgorm in Darnassus, avenging the desecration of an ancient night elf temple dedicated to Elune.
As a Horde adventurer, you present the head to Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff, earning the Cenarion Circle's trust and proving your dedication to cleansing Kalimdor's corruption.
